title: Median sale prices
text: The median sale price is now $520K, down 6% from a year ago and up 3.9% from five years ago. For buyers, that makes budgets easier to test against recently completed sales.

title: Price per square foot
text: Price per square foot is now $257, down 2.1% from a year ago. Buyers comparing homes of similar size and condition can use this to judge whether a price is reasonable.

title: Available homes
text: There are 492 homes available now, down 9.9% from a year ago and down 25.1% from five years ago. Buyers have a smaller selection to choose from, so comparing options quickly matters.

title: Median days on market
text: The median days on market is 54, down 5.3% from a year ago. Sellers can use that figure to plan a marketing timeline, though it is not a promised sale date.

title: Homes sold
text: A total of 186 homes sold in the 3 months ending October, down 14.3% from a year ago. Sellers can use these completed sales as evidence when reviewing their asking price.

title: Sales above, at and below asking
text: Above asking was the largest sales group, more common than last year.
